messages:
maria: Escalation from Acme — several users report SSO failures right after our cert rotation at ~10:02UTC. They get 403 from ACS.
kevin-cs: Customer says error page shows: "SAML assertion recipient mismatch" then 403. Worked fine earlier today.
aj: any request IDs or logs we can attach?
maria: attaching app proxy logs (redacted). short snippet:
```
2026-07-14T10:02:12Z ERROR saml: recipient mismatch: expected https://app.acme.com/saml/acs but got https://app.acme.com/saml/acs/
2026-07-14T10:02:12Z ERROR saml: signature verify failed: no matching cert found for KeyInfo thumbprint 3A:4C:5D:...
2026-07-14T10:02:13Z WARN http: upstream returned 403 for POST /saml/acs (relaystate=null)
```

sam-idp: quick thought — trailing-slash normalization + metadata cached w/old cert ordering can both cause this. Did Acme also rotate IdP keys?
kevin-cs: they said they rotated their signing cert right before ours (they did a deploy at 09:58UTC). we asked them to confirm metadata URL but they posted a file, not the URL.
aj: can we reproduce locally?
maria: spun a repro proxy and replayed the POST (redacted SAMLResponse). Repro shows identical recipient URL mismatch if ACS normalization differs. Also signature fails if the IdP provided a different primary signingKey ordering.

sam-idp: share their IdP metadata and we'll check key order + cert chain. if they uploaded a file, might have multiple <KeyDescriptor use="signing"> entries — some SPs pick the first one, others check all. our metadata fetcher picks the first compatible cert by order.

maria: pasted their metadata (redacted) and our quick diff:
```
- <KeyDescriptor use="signing"> cert thumbprint: 9B:AA:... (old)
- <KeyDescriptor use="signing"> cert thumbprint: 3A:4C:... (new)
+ Our fetcher previously cached 9B:AA and didn't pick up 3A:4C because of a race on rotation polling interval.
```

aj: short-term mitigation: we can accept either cert for 1 hour by adding second cert to the trusted key list for that tenant, or add a normalized ACS alias (no-trailing-slash) to avoid recipient mismatch while they fix IdP metadata.

maria: customer wants fastest fix; asked if we can do the accept-either-cert fallback.
sam-idp: I can add the fallback for the tenant and trigger an immediate metadata refresh. steps I ran:
```bash
# force metadata refresh for tenant acme-corp
POST https://console.redwood/api/internal/tenants/acme-corp/actions/refresh-idp
# verify certs:
curl -s https://idp.acme.com/metadata | xmllint --xpath 'string(//KeyDescriptor[1]/KeyInfo/X509Data/X509Certificate)' - | openssl x509 -inform PEM -noout -fingerprint -sha1
```

support-bot: created incident INC-1234 and linked to ticket TKT-7890 :ticket:
deploy-bot: scheduled config change in staging at 12:05UTC for rollback testing.

aj: after adding fallback, I see successful SAML validation in logs for 2 test users. need to watch metrics for 30m.
maria: told customer we applied temporary fallback and asked IdP to publish canonical metadata URL and ensure <KeyDescriptor> ordering includes new cert first; also asked them to normalize ACS (remove trailing slash) or include both variants on their side.

kevin-cs: customer confirmed logins working for 95% of users now, remaining fail cases appear to have old cached sessions — asking them to clear cached SSO cookies and try again.

sam-idp: follow-up action items:
- make IDP poller pick newest cert by fingerprint timestamp instead of list order (ENG-12345)
- add ACS normalization to tolerant matching for 302/POST redirects (ENG-12346)
- keep fallback for tenant for 1 hour then remove and verify (manual)

maria: closing loop with customer now. will attach repro steps and the short-term mitigation to INC-1234. thanks all :pray:
